## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 23.08.2026 - 23.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _HEMA SETH_, 23.08.2026, 1/5: "I accidentally purchased the annual subscription because I misunderstood the pricing. I believed I was agreeing to a much smaller recurring payment, but approximately ₹7,000 was charged upfront through Google Play. I cancelled the AutoPay mandate immediately and contacted support, requesting a refund for this accidental purchase. I hope the team reviews my case fairly and improves the pricing and purchase flow . And After 4 Days i Also Didn't Receive my Money Back. 😢😢"

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 17.03.2026 - 08.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Robin med Z_, 17.03.2026, 2/5: "Overpriced. No way to share with partner without breaking the rules. app crashes. THERES NOT EVEN AN ACTUAL WAY TO INCREASE INTENSITY WITHIN THE PLAN WHEN ITS WAY TOO EASY."
            2. _Barrett_, 08.08.2026, 4/5: "great app -- used Fitify since 2020! one problem since the ~2024 redesign: it forgets my workout progress and bugs out if i reply to a text/switch apps for a sec. will change review to 5 star when that gets fixed 🙂‍↕️"
<!--/ir-theme-->
